name: Democratic Republic of the Congo
shortSummary: India has contributed significant peacekeeping forces to the UN mission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (MONUSCO) over the years, alongside modest bilateral trade.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: India has been among the largest troop contributors to the UN stabilisation mission in the DRC.

sources.title: Bilateral brief
